findings.claim: When firm.yaml names no thresholds path, the fallback test is path.exists(), which is False for a broken symlink. An indicators.yaml at the case root that is a symlink to a moved or missing file therefore opens the case with the packaged thresholds instead of refusing, although the firm put a thresholds file there (design.md:1298, 1423: no case opens with silently different flags). It is softened by the panel now showing 'Thresholds from cma/thresholds/indicators.yaml (shipped with this tool)'.
findings.repro: With CMA_HOME set and no firm.yaml, run `ln -s /nonexistent/t.yaml $CMA_HOME/indicators.yaml`, import the QUEUE statement from tests/test_workspace_indicators.py and GET /api/case. The state is 'shown' with thresholds.shipped true, not refused. Using `path.exists() or path.is_symlink()` would refuse it via load_thresholds.
